rubrics.justification: Mostly reasonable blastocyst description, but it overstates certainty about ICM/TE quality from a single image and makes questionable claims about exact stage/zona thinning and a visible polar body/fragment.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior outcomes, sperm factors, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality well, though some links are speculative.
Generally structured and logical, but the strong emphasis on a Day-4/2AA discrepancy and large probability penalties for smoking/alcohol are somewhat speculative and not fully supported.

Many recommendations are standard, but several are not guideline-based or are controversial for this scenario (routine PGT-A at age 32, ERA, NK/immunologic testing, thrombophilia workup, broad add-on supplements).
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer support, lifestyle counseling, monitoring, and future workup, though some suggested tests/interventions may be unnecessary.
